author: reek
body: Proves the deck builder now runs a mana-artifact package. A mono-red deck built from the authored library pool should contain the on-colour mana rocks (Black Lotus, Mox Ruby, Sol Ring, Basalt Monolith, Fellwar Stone -- the first five usable-for-red artifacts, one of each), and the deck size must be unchanged at 60 (rocks replace that many basic lands). Off-colour Moxen (Pearl/Sapphire/Jet/ Emerald) must NOT be in a red deck.
